newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA ups stake in Comair to 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: NSA ups stake in Comair to 30 pct.

text.p: Investment trust company NSA Investments Ltd announced on Tuesday it had increased its shareholding in Commercial Airways Ltd (Comair) to 30 percent from 20 percent with effect from July 1 1996.
It said the 10 percent shareholding was acquired in terms of an option granted to NSA at the time of acquiring the initial 20 percent holding.
NSA said Comair had exceeded NSA's requirements for growth and return on investment.
Comair's recently announced agency agreement with British Airways was expected to position the business to take advantage of the growing airline passenger market in South Africa, the company added.
